Class PersistenceManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.persistence.PersistenceManager
public class PersistenceManager extends Object
Manages saving and restoring games to/from disk (Persistence feature).

Each game is saved as saves/game_{id}.json using Jackson. Saving occurs after every turn transition; the file is deleted when the game ends normally.

On server restart, loadAll() reads all existing files and restore(GameSnapshot) reconstructs the full object graph using the card catalogue from a fresh Deck (already present in the Game after new Game(id)).

    • restore

      public Game restore(GameSnapshot snap)
      Reconstructs a complete Game object from a GameSnapshot.

      Strategy:

      1. Creates new Game(id) — the constructor produces a fresh main deck with all cards.
      2. Builds a cardId → Card catalogue from mainDeck.getAllCards().
      3. Reconstructs each Player (with their cards, without side-effects).
      4. Reconstructs the board rows, totems on spaces, and the TurnOrder.
      5. Calls game.restorePersistedState() to set all non-final fields.
      Parameters:
      snap - the snapshot to restore from
      Returns:
      a fully initialised Game reflecting the saved state
